provenance_note: The engine clone has no configs/BASIC_DIALOGUE_QA_POLICY.json. Every threshold below is taken verbatim from the engine code that already enforces it, so this file records the engine's behaviour rather than inventing a new one: source_video_dialogue_gate.py (--minimum-recall default 0.55, failure codes, whisper transcribe settings), run_regression_ci.speech_density_stats (15.0 / 10.0 segments per minute), source_video_dialogue_gate.NORMALISE (orthographic variants), apply_asr_homophone_adjudication.py (machine_adjudication type HOMOPHONE_OR_SCRIPT_VARIANT).

rules.recall_metric: SequenceMatcher matching-block ratio over CJK-only text; a substring match scores 1.0 (source_video_dialogue_gate.recall)

homophone_handling.principle: A homophone or orthographic variant is RECORDED, never REJECTED.
homophone_handling.detail: When the ASR transcript diverges from the authored line only in characters whose pinyin (tone-insensitive) is identical, or only by a declared orthographic variant, the divergence is written into the QA record as a machine_adjudication row and the line still counts as PRESENT. It never contributes to a REJECT and it never triggers a reroll.
